stem.text: When sound travels through air, the air particles vibrate. A graph of displacement against time for a single air particle is shown.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled displacement and horizontal axis labelled time, marked 0, T and 2T. A wave-shaped curve crosses the time axis, with peaks above and troughs below it.
